text:
sam (partnerships): Heads-up 1: ISV compatibility sprint kickoff: LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters, cloud marketplace listing mechanics (AWS/GCP), and Nimbus hardware benchmark badge. Goal: certified connector + marketplace tile by end of month. Can we map owners + blockers?

ana (eng-ml): I'll take the connector functional tests. Need to validate: streaming behavior, tool-calling passthrough, and KV cache consistency for LlamaIndex indexes. Will create a test matrix (models x seq x cache_on/off).

leo (product): I'll own marketplace metadata, pricing SKU, and the tile copy. Question: do we want a performance badge ("Nimbus Verified") or a "Recommended for low-latency" tag? Marco, can Nimbus commit to a perf threshold?

marco (nimbus-hw): Nimbus can run the perf suite. Proposed thresholds: p95 < 250ms for seq<=512 on redwood-1.5-slim @ batch=4, and throughput >= 120 req/s on a 2xA100-equivalent node for seq=256. If that works, we can do a badge. Need a reproducible harness (k8s + helm) and a workload spec.

rachel (solutions): I'll build a small reference app that wires LangChain -> Redwood Gateway -> LlamaIndex. Demo will include infra-as-code (Helm chart + terraform var hints) and an end-to-end perf test script. ETA: demo PR by Wed.

kevin (eng-platform): Important: marketplace listings require telemetry toggles to be off by default. We'll need a privacy blurb and opt-in pattern for telemetry. Also confirm marketplace IAM roles and token rotation. I'll draft the security checklist.

sam (partnerships): Good. Timeline suggestion: feature freeze for connectors + demo by 2026-06-10, Nimbus runs perf 2026-06-11 to 2026-06-15, marketplace soft-listing 2026-06-18, public announcement ~2026-06-25. Objections?

ana (eng-ml): Works for me if we get the prompt set + long-dialog failing cases by Fri. I'll add a stress test for memory pressure (multi-index retrieval + context window churn).

leo (product): I'll draft marketplace tile + pricing options (free trial + paid tier) and the short privacy blurb. Will post PR link in this thread.

marco (nimbus-hw): For the harness, we prefer a job spec in k8s that hits the gateway endpoint with the same token patterns customers would use. Can you include an option to pin model variants (quantized vs full) so we can compare?

kevin (eng-platform): Yes. Also note: dedicated deployments may have different routing rules; include a routing policy example to show fallback to smaller model variants under capacity constraints. Example snippet: 

```yaml
routing:
  - priority: low_latency
    route: gateway-us-east-1
    fallback: redwood-lite
  - priority: cost
    route: gateway-eu-1
    fallback: redwood-1.5-quant
```

rachel (solutions): Demo repo skeleton: https://git.redwood.ai/demos/llamaindex-langchain-connector (WIP). Includes sample Helm chart charts/ll-index-demo and a smoke test script run_smoke.sh.

ci-bot: CI update: connectors-integration pipeline queued (ci-4121). Tests will run on merge to main.

ana (eng-ml): Small gotcha: LlamaIndex v0.7 changed the index serialization format. We should certify against v0.6 and v0.7 and include a migration note in the marketplace docs. I'll add converters to the test harness.

leo (product): Noted. We'll add compatibility badges: "Works with LlamaIndex v0.6" and "v0.7 compatible (migration may be required)".

marco (nimbus-hw): We'll need a stable tag for the demo image to run benchmarks. Please publish a staging image with digest.

rachel (solutions): Staging image will be ghcr.io/redwood/ll-index-demo:staging-20260601 and I'll post the digest once CI completes.

kevin (eng-platform): Security note: marketplace integrations must document data retention and KMS usage. Sam/Leo, please include a KMS integration note and an example of how to configure customer-managed keys in the tile docs.

sam (partnerships): Action list recap: Ana = test matrix + prompt set; Rachel = demo repo + Helm + image; Leo = marketplace copy + privacy + SKU; Kevin = security checklist + routing examples; Marco = Nimbus perf run coordination. Status update by EOD Thu so we can lock the freeze date.

ana (eng-ml): Will upload test matrix (CSV) and prompt set (10 canonical cases + 3 failing long-dialogs) by Thu AM.

leo (product): PR: https://git.redwood.ai/marketplace/llamaindex-connector PR #88 (draft). Adding copy and screenshots today.

rachel (solutions): Demo PR opened draft: https://git.redwood.ai/demos/llamaindex-langchain-connector/pulls/4 (contains Helm and smoke test).

marco (nimbus-hw): Nimbus assigned eng@nimbus to run the perf window 2026-06-11 to 2026-06-15. Please share the workload spec and image digest.

ci-bot: Build passed for demo image (ci-4121) 1: image available ghcr.io/redwood/ll-index-demo@sha256:abcdef1234567890

sam (partnerships): Awesome. If no blockers by Thu, we'll lock dates and start partner comms. Thanks everyone :rocket:
